Nation Marks Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's 151st Birth Anniversary

India observed the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, with leaders paying tribute to him as the 'Architect of Akhand Bharat'. Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Raman Singh stated that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Foundation Day greetings served as an inspiration to the people of Chhattisgarh.
